{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the premises
print("Number of rows:", len(df))
print("Channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Customer segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Refunded orders count:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check if any row has revenue = 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Check if refunded orders are included
print("After removing QA orders, refunded count:", (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Convert revenue to float (though not needed for conversion rate)
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm that converted is int64
print("`converted` dtype:", df_clean['converted'].dtype)

# Display first few rows
df_clean[['channel', 'customer_segment', 'converted', 'status']].head()"}
